name: bad-release
description: The incident of the demo. search-service 2.1.0 has been shipped over 2.0.0 and every search fails, while its pod stays Running and Ready because /healthz still answers. The agent is called with the text chat-assistant's alert hook sends. It must find the cause in the pod's log, not in the pod's status, and recommend the version the Deployment retains.
question: Alert SearchErrorRateHigh is firing for service search-service. More than half of all searches have failed for 1 minute. Investigate and report the suspected cause, the evidence and the version to roll back to.
